episodes.synopsis: The queen announces Pride's engagement on her 16th birthday. It may seem like the perfect match, but Pride knows it's anything but a fairy tale.
episodes.title: The Cruel Queen and the Fiance

episodes.synopsis: Pride knows what lies in store for Leon, and she is determined to safeguard her fiance's happiness. However, Pride's friends worry that she isn't safeguarding her own.
episodes.title: The Cruel Queen Speaks

episodes.synopsis: Pride will not suffer a conspiracy aimed at Prince Leon.
episodes.title: The Cruel Queen and the Truth

episodes.synopsis: With Leon and the Anemone Kingdom destined to fall into ruin, Pride confronts the conspirators directly.
episodes.title: The Cruel Queen Makes a Declaration

episodes.synopsis: With the engagement behind her, Pride faces the future with what her evil counterpart never had: people who care for her.
episodes.title: The Cruel Queen Takes Notice, and is Noticed

episodes.synopsis: Roles and priorities may change, but that doesn't mean bonds disappear.
episodes.title: The Audacious Queen and Alcohol

episodes.synopsis: According to the game, Prince Cedric is meant to be Tiara's future fiancé. But the script changes when he sets his eyes on Pride instead.
episodes.title: The Cruel Queen and Alliance Negotiations

episodes.synopsis: Cedric doesn't understand how close he is to causing an international incident. Pride may not like him, but she can't allow such a mistake to happen.
episodes.title: The Diabolical Princess and the Fool

episodes.synopsis: The Kingdom of Copelandii will invade sooner than expected.
episodes.title: The Cruel Princess and the Request

episodes.synopsis: Cedric is wracked with guilt over the crisis facing his country, but Pride assures him that the future isn't set in stone.
episodes.title: The Cruel Princess and the Second-born Prince

episodes.synopsis: When tensions between allied kingdoms rise, Pride must cross a closed border to discover the reason why.
episodes.title: The Blasphemous Princess Prepares Herself

episodes.synopsis: Three nations unite after Pride gambles with her life and vows to protect her allies.
episodes.title: The Blasphemous Princess Takes a Stand
